text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Next up is... Um... What was it again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's another day off, and as I'm out for a
walk, I spot Special Week. She has a
troubled expression on her her face, so I
decide to head
her way for a quick chat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Right now, I'm practicing how
to be a tour guide!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, my mom is coming down to visit me.
She said she wanted to see
how I'm doing
at school!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So I wanted to give her a quick tour of
the
area. I have to look like I
know my way
around!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So I've been practicing...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I still haven't gotten the hang of it, haha... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: R-really?! That'd be great!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In that case, can you pretend to be my
mom? That way, it'll be closer
to the real
deal.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! You're my mom for today—my
one-day mom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Special Week's Special Tour
begins with an interesting start.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh... I think it's this way. Actually, it
might've been that way. Yeah, I
think
that's it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
D-don't worry! According to my phone,
the mall should be straight
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, I know where we are! I was so
focused on the map that I
didn't notice
anything else!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I come here pretty often!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This area's really quiet,
so it's the perfect
place to hide away and
relax!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Even if it's nothing like what you'd
see back in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Being here reminds me of the fact that,
despite being so far from
home, my mom
and I live under the same sky.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of her motivates me to put my all
into my life here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And afterwards, on the way back, I stop by
the market. They make
the most amazing
pickled veggies. They're sooo good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, this way! There's actually a
shortcut we can take to get there!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Well,
if it isn't Spe! Are you here for the
usual?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! Two jars of your special
pickled veggies!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... The pickled veggies here are
perfect—a balanced mix of sweet and
acidic, all while staying super crunchy!
"Special" hardly
even covers it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, speaking of "special"...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Have a cup of my specially-mixed
juice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I made this over at the drink fountain
using my patented mixing
method! As for the taste,
well... give it a sip and find out for 
yourself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She places the glass of brown liquid on
the table. As I look at the
peculiar concoction,
a slew of words come to mind, but "juice"
is not one of them.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I always make sure to throw one of these
together whenever I come
here to study
with El and the others!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If one of us nods off or gets a problem
wrong, we have to take a sip!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the one who ends up drinking
most of it though...
Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: This juice tastes just like how you would imagine! It makes you go "Blegh!" But I kinda like it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It contains all the joy, laughter, and
excitement that fills this room
whenever
we're here. It's special like that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! Down the hatch it goes!
I'll
order a carrot hamburger
steak to help get
the taste out of your mouth afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They taste a bit different from the
ones my
mom makes, but not in a
bad way! Each
bite packs its own punch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I think I'll order one for myself
too! ♪ Excuse me! Two carrot
hamburger
steaks, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After our brief lunch break, Special Week
continues to show me
around town.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmmm. ♪ It's already evening,
huh? I guess we should start
heading
ba—wait...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhgh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I totally forgot about the tour! We were
supposed to go to the
landmark locations,
but we ended up going to all my usual
spots!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It must've slipped my mind somehow...
What do I do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom said she wanted to see how I'm
doing here... She would've
been so
disappointed by my tour...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
B-but... we didn't even get to go to the
mall or see the river...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be good if she knew that I
was visiting places unique to
this area...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I think I get it. When I first came
here, I couldn't tell left from
right. But now
I know enough to find my way around
town!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! I was missing the point
this whole time. Thank you for
helping me
realize that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna give my mom a tour
only I could ever give! She'll
be happy for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eep! My stomach...
I relaxed too quickly...
Ha... haha...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... Oh, right! Since we're already out,
do you mind if we stop by
one last place?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go to my favorite ramen shop!
They give you gargantuan
servings!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Their "Super Gargantuan XXL
Ramen" is really famous! The
bowl's bigger
than my head!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Anyway, hurry up! Let's get going already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Special Week eats any more than she
already has, it might start to affect her
running. I hurriedly follow behind her to
make sure she's
kept in check.
